text: invokeEventDragSession writes the calendar item under application/vnd.x-moz-cal-item and serializes the same item into text/calendar and text/plain for external applications. Internal containers check the typed format before reading it. A copy receives a new item ID and an add transaction; a move uses modify with the original item. Keep producers and consumers on the same payload contract. Timed day/week items use mouse-sweep handlers; month items use native drag events. The current sweep still says dragging to the all-day header fails, so this landing does not establish that all drag paths are fixed.
title: Calendar drag payloads combine a typed item with portable ICS
